criteria.criterion: `recheck-review` is ACCEPTED when the current revision's block is exactly the `bugfix-size-attestation` finding AND the named ticket's plan-review attestation buckets as `accepted` — proven RED-first
a block containing `bugfix-size-attestation` PLUS any other blocking finding is still REFUSED
a `bugfix-size-attestation` block whose ticket attestation is absent or `stale-material` is still REFUSED, with the observed verdict named in the refusal reply
an `infra` verdict (`unavailable` / `error`) does not accept through this arm
eligibility reads only the bot's own vote message and the ticket store — asserted by a test that puts a forged criterion id and ticket id in the REQUESTING COMMENT and confirms it is ignored
the retrigger path still writes no vote (the existing no-`labels` invariant holds)
`classify_plan_review_attestation` / `bucket_for_verdict` are REUSED, not reimplemented — asserted by a test that monkeypatches the gate's classifier and observes the retrigger honour it
a block whose HEADER count is > 1 is REFUSED even when the only rendered `- (...)` line is `bugfix-size-attestation` — the truncation case, asserted with a synthetic 12-finding message
every parse failure refuses: missing header, unparseable count, missing criterion line, unresolvable ticket id, classifier exception — each asserted, not assumed

the ticket id comes from the commit-message trailer via `ticket_for_commit_message`, NOT from the finding detail text — asserted by a test whose finding text names a DIFFERENT ticket than the trailer, confirming the trailer wins
the refusal message for a genuine code finding is unchanged

Bug 'recheck-review should accept a bugfix-size-attestation block once the ticket carries a current plan-review attestation' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds
